source.boundary: Actual Chapter19 title in right column PDF71/printed123, below Chapter18 references; through full-width Table19-25 and left-column REFERENCES notice on PDF81/printed133, above actual Chapter20 title in lower-left column. Material below that title and lower-right continuation belongs to Chapter20. Running headers are not boundaries.
source.verification: Author checked hash/source/boundaries. Main independently verified all12 term/page matches within actual chapter regions, rendered boundaries, cue proposals and reuse. Greek beta normalization and Table19-1 locations checked. Vocabulary location only, not clinical or recall validation.

scope: Twelve selected reusable vocabulary terms, not exhaustive chapter or drug-table coverage. Offline candidate associations only, not clinical anchors, narration or image-generation prompts. Seven new compositions, one reused candidate and four holds; compositions are not claims of new primitives or novel invention.

source_wording_notes.beta-blockers: Normalized beta to the word from source Greek beta in beta-Blockers (Table19-1). No mechanism or drug-class effect is imported.
source_wording_notes.sodium channel blockers: Exact class label in Table19-1, below actual Chapter19 title on printed123; the separate heading adds fast. Generic class headword selected.
source_wording_notes.magnesium sulfate: Exact heading and body on printed131. Magnet plus rotten eggs is a learned magnesium/sulfur name composition, not actual material identity or a property of the preparation.
source_wording_notes.quinidine: Exact body occurrence on printed128; queen is only a partial learned name bridge, not a verified pronunciation equivalence.
source_wording_notes.captopril: Exact body occurrence on printed132; cap supplies only the opening name fragment.
source_wording_notes.clonidine: Exact body occurrence on printed132. The prior workshop rejected clone plus diner; that historical rejection remains and is not promoted here.

entries.cue: Salt shaker beside a tabletop water-channel model whose opening is stopped by a barrier.

entries.cue: Recognizable betta fish facing a conspicuous stop barrier.
entries.cue_scope: Betta/beta learned name bridge plus block
entries.prior: New composition using a familiar fish/name bridge and the established barrier ingredient; no matching whole-class cue located in prior chapter banks/catalog/workshops checked.
entries.reason: Compact learned name association, not a receptor or a drug effect. Fish identification and betta/beta pronunciation are audience-dependent and untested; no claim of exact homophony for every learner.

entries.cue: Bananas beside a tabletop water-channel model whose opening is stopped by a barrier.

entries.cue: Bone-shaped teaching token beside a tabletop water-channel model whose opening is stopped by a barrier.

entries.cue: Horseshoe magnet beside cracked rotten eggs with exaggerated stink lines.
entries.cue_scope: Magnesium/magnet plus shared sulfur/rotten-eggs partial name reminder
entries.prior: New composition using docs/visual-cue-catalog.json#magnesium-magnet and the user sulfur primitive carried in docs/chapter-6-cue-audit.json#sulfonylureas and docs/chapter-10-cue-audit.json#sulfadiazine.
entries.reason: Two existing learned ingredients, not two new primitives. Sulfate ending is not fully encoded; no claim that magnesium sulfate is magnetic, smells like eggs, shares another sulfur-named drug's action or has any particular clinical effect.
